description: Plan a change without editing files

---
Plan this work without making changes:

$ARGUMENTS

Rules:
- Stay in planning-only mode for this thread.
- Do not edit, write, delete, format, commit, stage, or push files.
- Reading files and running safe inspection commands is allowed.
- Ask clarifying questions if the scope is unclear.
- Continue planning-only through follow-up discussion.
- Exit planning-only mode only if I explicitly ask to implement, or if I use `/implement`.

Produce:
- Goal
- Relevant context found
- Proposed approach
- Files likely to change
- Risks and open questions
- Validation plan
- Suggested branch name
- Suggested explicit plan file path, if this should become a Herdr/Pi task
